notes.title: Our new game, Ware's Laboratory!
notes.content: [p]Hello! Yuhyna Mriia here.[/p][p][/p][p]I am thrilled to announce that we are preparing to release our second game — and its Steam page is public now![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3967510/Wares_Laboratory/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]It's an atmospheric horror game inspired by retro titles and myths about them. If you liked Bonjin ~ An Ordinary Man, take a look at the new game — the retro graphics, emphasis on story, and queer characters are still here, but this time, with more gameplay![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45468318/c2e7c50d280b30d60453baf3c24aa391f273b610.png"][/img][/p][p]I hope to release Ware's Laboratory this November or December. If you're interested, please wishlist it and share it with your friends![/p]
